purpose: Teach: たどり着い/サス/塀/乗用車/新生/捕らえ/クライマックス/盛りだくさん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ようやく、駅に、たどり着いたね、雨で、遅くなっちゃったよね、私たち、本当に、お疲れ様。
lines.en: Riku, we finally made it to the station. The rain really held us up, didn't it?
lines.style: Wry and slightly self-mocking. Light, quick delivery — acknowledging shared ordeal without making it dramatic. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。最近、サスペンス映画、見るのが、結構、好きになったぜ、桜、お前、興味、ある?
lines.en: Yeah. I've been getting pretty into suspense movies lately. You interested in checking one out?
lines.style: Casual probe, but with genuine curiosity underneath. Relaxed pace. Testing the waters, not pushing. Natural, unbothered tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 公園の塀、誰かが、ペンキで、いたずら描き、してたよ、リク、見た?悲しくなったよ、私、本当に。
lines.en: Someone spray-painted all over the park wall. Did you see it? It really got to me, honestly.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly troubled. Pause before 'honestly.' Quieter than before — something about it sits with her. Sincere, not performing concern.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんの会社の乗用車、結構、新しいの、増えてるって、聞いたぜ、桜、会社、好調なんだろうな。
lines.en: I heard your dad's company has been adding a lot of new cars to the fleet lately. Business must be going well.
lines.style: Casual observation, genuinely interested. Even pace. Light, conversational — mentioning something he overheard, not making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 新生女子バレー部の、入部、私、考えてるんだ、リク、応援してくれる?お願い、本当に。
lines.en: I'm thinking about joining the new girls' volleyball team. Will you support me? Please?
lines.style: Earnest and vulnerable. Slight hesitation before the ask. Needs this encouragement. Quiet conviction underneath, but genuinely asking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の写真、いい瞬間、捕らえるのが、本当に、上手いよな、桜、SNS、いつも、見てるぜ、本当に。
lines.en: You're really good at capturing great moments in your photos. I see your stuff on SNS all the time.
lines.style: Genuine compliment, slightly pleased. Not laying it on thick — matter-of-fact praise that carries weight because he means it. Natural, direct.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 青春のクライマックス、文化祭、もうすぐ、本気で、楽しみだよ、リク、お前と、たくさん、思い出、作ろうね。
lines.en: The cultural festival is coming up soon and it's going to be amazing. I want to make tons of memories with you.
lines.style: Animated and genuinely excited. Forward momentum in the delivery. Warmth breaking through his usual cool distance. Something sincere underneath the enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭のプログラム、本当に、盛りだくさんで、毎年、ワクワクするよな、桜、お前と一緒に、楽しみたいぜ。
lines.en: The festival lineup is packed with so much stuff. I get excited about it every year, and this time I want to enjoy it with you.
lines.style: Earnest and open. Softer attack than his usual cool. The cool-distance melting slightly. Genuine warmth, a little vulnerable in admitting he wants to do this with her.
